git_revision_note: The receipt ships with the commit it describes, so it cannot contain that commit's own identity. The branch freebuff/windows-test-performance-under-concurrent-load and pull request #199 carry it.
execution_mode: local desktop agent in one dedicated worktree on the shared laboratory VM; measurement commands run against this checkout only; no other campaign's worktree, branch or process was modified
model_note: Not exposed to agent tools. No paid provider was connected, no credits purchased, no additional AI worker launched, and no other campaign's agent was altered.

source.detail: Instrumented test runs and microbenchmark reports written by this campaign's own harness, plus the home-directory campaign registry.

coverage: Two full portable suite executions on 2026-11-26 and 2026-11-27 (727 and 799 tests), one controlled two-arm fixture comparison, two focused Git-command-mix runs, one bounded microbenchmark session of 8 iterations across 12 benchmarks, and a before/after comparison pass. Host conditions recorded by the harness for every run.
attribution_limits: Host CPU, memory, process and thread counts describe a shared VM and are not provider consumption. Suite wall-clock is test execution time, not agent session time. Microbenchmark durations are host observations. No per-campaign or account-level provider allowance is observable to the agent.
status: complete: reusable harness published, two-run structural analysis, one import defect corrected (recovering 72 tests), one cross-campaign version-skew hazard documented, one test-synchronization finding handed to the branch that already fixes it
measurement_note: Provider allowance, tokens, context size and quota remain unobservable to the agent; no figure is estimated or inferred from a shared account meter. measured_test_wall_clock sums instrumented test execution only and excludes agent session time: 1284.3 s + 918.6 s for the two full runs, plus 45.8 s across the smoke run and the two-arm fixture comparison, plus 197.1 s for the two Git-command-mix runs. Campaign activity counts are reported as activity, not as provider consumption. The microbenchmark session was repeated after the host-CPU correction: 12 benchmarks x 8 iterations twice.
private_evidence: Raw run JSON, host timelines, logs, comparison artifacts and the campaign registry are retained outside Git under the laboratory private-evidence directory; only the harness, the analysis and these reviewed receipts are published.
